center_of_gravity: The material operation and physical asymmetry of hollow clay envelopes and enclosed counters, anchored by the attested specimen OIM A64678.
what_is_happening: Small clay counters are enclosed in moist clay to form a hollow envelope; the envelope is sealed, may receive exterior impressions and seal rollings, and dries into an opaque sphere.
what_changes_during_passage: Loose, directly visible counters become sealed within an opaque hollow sphere where contents are hidden from view, establishing a physical asymmetry where direct inspection destroys the sealed container, while surface marks on some specimens allow quantity to be read without immediate breakage.
begins_at: Handling small geometric clay counters and wrapping workable moist clay around them to form a hollow envelope.
stops_before: Transitioning to solid numerical tablets (such as ChM III-937a), proto-cuneiform tablets, or proposing any evolutionary progression from envelopes to tablets.
